note: Patterns extracted from inspecting Open Lovable's stack and typical outputs. Aspirational items are listed but not imported by our scaffolder — we keep the minimal stack pinned in SandpackPreview.tsx.
layout_principles: py-20 between sections on desktop, py-12 on mobile
mobile-first responsive grid: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3
hero is centered and tall (min py-28)

motion_conventions.section_reveal: scroll-into-view; we approximate with on-mount animate-fade-up

saas-marketing: Home: hero -> logo-cloud -> feature-spotlight -> pricing-band -> testimonials -> cta-band
ecommerce-boutique: Home: hero -> featured-collection -> brand-story -> press -> newsletter

content_principles: Brand names should fit the niche (never 'platform', 'studio', 'app').
Use real-sounding people names in testimonials (e.g., 'Maya Patel, Lead Engineer at Stripe').
Pricing copy should be concrete ('Up to 50 projects', not 'Unlimited everything').
Empty section is better than lorem ipsum.
